'''Gapillian grazers''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. They were gentle-tempered beasts that wandered the [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] meadows of the planet, although their massive curved tusks and their hides, that looked like an armor, could give them a fearsome appearance. People could often get near them without being threatened, but, during their mating season, grazers could become a huge menace for anyone who tried to approach them; during this season the [[Gender/Legends|male]] specimens saw every approaching being as a "love threat" and, as a defensive action, a single spooked grazer could initiate a charge capable of leveling a small town.
